purpose: Document local registry evidence, language-specific searches and bounded anonymous geometry-route review.
assessment: The Egyptian Survey Authority is the official mapping agency, and government-published notices identify the Suez Survey Directorate and city-specific map/field work in Suez. ESA’s official topographic map guide includes Suez Governorate. These establish a local survey/cadastral-map custodian, not an anonymous parcel vector endpoint or proof of a local private-title registry. No public anonymous parcel-vector endpoint or geometry-only feature response identified. ESA’s published digital-map purchase workflow requires a location, scale, layers and quotation/payment.
